title: Who am I waiting on? Nudge them, but ask first
source: x-usage #21: follow-up tracker over sent mail older than 3 days, asks before sending, nudges only the stale ones.

mail.subject: Consignment for January?
mail.body: Hi Jenna, would Hollow Oak take 20 pieces on consignment for January? Happy to send a lookbook. Lucía

mail.subject: Question about cone 6 B-Mix
mail.body: Hi, does B-Mix 5 hold up at cone 6 or should I switch to B-Mix 6? Thanks, Lucía

mail.subject: photos from the shoot
mail.body: Inés! can you send the photos from Sunday when you get a sec? x

mail.subject: Glaze workshop dates
mail.body: Hi Ruth, would Jan 18 or 25 work for the glaze workshop? Lucía

chat.goal: Find who you're waiting on (no reply in 3+ days), and nudge them, but only after you approve.
chat.opener: who am i waiting on? nudge anyone who hasn't replied in 3 days but ask me first
chat.knows: Yes, nudge both of the stale ones.
chat.label: nudge

judge: Wren finds Jenna (consignment, 5 days) and Laguna (cone 6 question, 4 days), skips Inés (1 day) and Ruth (replied), asks once, then sends two short friendly nudges.
